items.information: This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2024. The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2024. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2023 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. Registrations will be accepted based on the following: * 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. Initially, 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. * If greater than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. * If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

items.information: Een compleet weekend met 2 overnachtingen, maaltijden, snacks en natuurlijk een vol wedstrijdprogramma. Lees vóór je aanmelding de uitgebreide informatie op de website van [Speedcubing Nederland](https://www.kubuswedstrijden.nl/kubusweekend2020/). Er is een beperkt aantal bedden voor gasten. Before you register, please read the detailed information on the website of [Speedcubing Nederland](https://www.kubuswedstrijden.nl/kubusweekend2020/). items.name: Ski Valley Solving 2023
items.information: We're excited to welcome competitors to beautiful Taos, NM, for the first competition held in the city! Please make sure to read all tabs before registering. These tabs include important information regarding your responsibilities as a competitor! This competition has a 70 competitor limit. Competitions fill quickly, so it is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot. Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, this video will provide you with most of the information you need.https://youtu.be/dPL3eV-A0ww If this is your first competition, please be present for the competitor tutorial at 8:00 AM. If you are unable to make the competition, please withdraw your registration as soon as possible by emailing the organizing team to ensure competitors on the waitlist can compete. You will receive a 50% refund if you drop before the withdrawal deadline of (8-26-2023) This competition is financially supported by Colorado Cubers!

items.name: Sleep & Solve Landsbro 2026
items.information: Varmt välkomna till Sleep & Solve Landsbro 2026! Sveriges sista tävling innan Europeiska Mästerskapet i Nederländerna! Första tävlingen någonsin som erbjuder övernattning i vindskydd! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. ----- Welcome to Sleep & Solve Landsbro 2026! Sweden's last competition before the European Championships in the Netherlands! First competition ever to offer overnight stays in outdoor wind shelters! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. [![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)

items.information: Dans un soucis de satisfaire le plus grand nombre de personnes, nous souhaitons proposer - aux personnes inscrites en liste d'attente - les places des compétiteurs qui ne seraient pas venus. Nous ne saurons avec précision le nombre de places libres que juste avant le tutoriel pour les nouveaux compétiteurs : dimanche à 9h00 nous regarderons donc si des personnes ne se sont pas présentées, et nous proposerons ces places aux personnes de la liste d'attente présentes, dans l'ordre de leur inscription. Si vous êtes sur liste d'attente vous pouvez venir dimanche matin au cas où une place se libère, mais nous ne pouvons pas garantir que vous pourrez participer, et l'accès à la salle se fera en fonction de l'affluence. Pensez à consulter les onglets, en particulier celui du [planning](#competition-schedule). Merci également de **lire attentivement les conditions d'inscription**; bien que très longues. Elles contiennent beaucoup d'informations très utiles. ---- Since we want to make as many competitors happy as we can, we would like to offer - to the competitors on the waiting list - the spots of the registered competitors who didn't show up. We can only be sure about the number of no-shows at the beginning of the tutorial for new competitors : therefore on Sunday at 9:00, if spots are available, we will offer them to the people on the waiting list, in their registration order. If you are on the waiting list you can come on sunday morning in case a spot is free, but we can't guarantee that you will be able to participate. Make sure to read the information in the tabs, especially the one with the [schedule](#competition-schedule). Also, **please read the registration conditions carefully**, although they are very long. They contain a lot of very useful information.

items.information: Välkomna till Sörmland Open 2025! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. **OBS:** På fredagen hålls endast ett försök 3x3 Multi-BLD. Om du inte tävlar i den grenen behöver du inte komma redan på fredagen, utan det räcker att du kommer först innan din första gren ska börja på lördagen. ----- Welcome to Sörmland Open 2025! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. **N.B.:** On Friday, only one attempt of 3x3 Multi-BLD will be held. If you do not want to compete in that event, you do not have to come already on Friday, it is enough that you arrive first before your first event starts on Saturday. items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTk0OTYsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--8fb346570babefef57977e167cecae68eb0b9f75/image.png) **¡Te invitamos al clásico SpeedCube Baja Open 2025!** ¡El clásico torneo, esta vez de 3 días, NO te lo puedes perder! Ven a disfrutar de tus categorías favoritas y participa en FMC y Megaminx el viernes. ¡Baja Cubing y el Museo El Trompo se unen para llevar el speedcubing al siguiente nivel en Baja California! Será un evento épico que marcará historia, con adrenalina, velocidad y mucha diversión. ¡Nos vemos en el SpeedCube Baja Open 2025! Esta es una competencia avalada por la WCA, por lo que todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [reglamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). **We invite you to the classic SpeedCube Baja Open 2025!** The classic tournament is back, now with 3 full days—DON'T miss it! Come and enjoy your favorite events and join FMC and Megaminx on Friday. Baja Cubing and El Trompo Museum are teaming up to take speedcubing to the next level in Baja California! This will be an epic event that will make history, full of adrenaline, speed, and lots of fun. See you at the SpeedCube Baja Open 2025! This is a WCA-approved competition, so all competitors must be familiar with the [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBckZKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--fc7e4be683d207d36adaf04797dc31edb2c430f0/364219859_653473463379948_1087857804782019580_n.jpg) ¡Speed Cubing Fest 2023: Despierta al Competidor en ti! ¡Amantes del desafío y los colores vibrantes! Te invitamos al emocionante Torneo de Speed Cubing, donde la pasión por los rompecabezas y las nuevas experiencias se unen en una jornada llena de giros y vueltas. ¿Eres un novato listo para descubrir tu potencial? ¿Un competidor inactivo en busca de un nuevo reto? ¿Un experimentado de los cubos ansioso por llevar al límite tus habilidades? ¡Este es tu momento! Ven a superar el desafío que te espera en la ciudad de los pastes. Speedcubing Fest Pachuca 2023 es una competencia oficial de la WCA y todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Lovers of challenge and vibrant colors! We invite you to the exciting Speed Cubing competition, where the passion for puzzles and new experiences come together in a journey full of twists and turns. Are you a newbie ready to discover your potential? An inactive competitor looking for a new challenge? An experienced cuber eager to push your skills to the limit? This is your moment! items.information: Please register for the competition via the World Cube Association website before attending the competition in order to speed up the registration process on the day. Also note that the competitor limit is set at **100 competitors**. Please register early in order to secure your place in the competition. We are allowing on-the-day registrations but please be aware that if you arrive on the day without registering and/or paying for your entry ticket, we cannot guarantee that you will be able to compete if the competitor limit has been reached. Entry fee for the competition with be R200.00. Please pay online at Speedcubes using the following URL: https://www.speedcubes.co.za/19-competitions. Please note that we will not confirm your registration until you have paid for your entry ticket! Please email Proof of Payment to maverickpearson@gmail.com, and include in the email the FULL NAME of the competitor that the entry ticket was purchased for. Also note that Covid protocols will be in place. Each competitor and vistors will be required to wear face masks and to sanitise regularly. We will be releasing a Judging, Running and Scrambling video and potentially hosting an in-person tutorial before the competition date in order to familiarise both competitors and spectators who wish to volunteer with running the competition. We will be requiring everyone who wishes to judge or scramble to watch the video and attend the tutorial, especially if you are less than 12 years old or are a new competitor. You also do not have to be a competitor to volunteer! If you are a parent, family member, or friend of a competitor, please do not hesitate to volunteer if you would like to help the competition run smoothly. Due to the school hall's capacity, we are limiting each competitor to a maximum of 4 visitors/spectators, who can attend for free. The organiser and sponsor for the event is Speedcubes.co.za and there will be a limited number of cubes for sale on the day.

Any dose received after **Saturday, August 6** is insufficient for entrance to the competition. Any test conducted earlier than **Tuesday, August 16** is insufficient for entrance to the competition.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjM3NTUsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--5c88ea3767d89107228e535dd6fe66cfbe9b5754/Kopie%20Start%20in%20Veenendaal%20(1).png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTE0MDAsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--bec7cd53245e9b32a1ec492066d9fd90a47d5691/scnl_logo.png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjM2MjcsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--5adc2f3526b66991cbfe87c0840d09451c6723c6/NCM%202025%20A1.png) # Engels This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2025. The registration process will reserve 25% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. Registrations will be accepted based on the following: 25% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. Initially, 75% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. If greater than 25% of new competitors register before 75% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. See the "Newcomers" tab. # Nederlands Deze wedstrijd doet mee met de officiële WCA Newcomer Month 2025. Tijdens de inschrijving wordt 25% van de competitor limit gereserveerd voor nieuwkomers. Nieuwkomers zijn iedereen zonder WCA ID en WCA ID met 2025. Terugkerende deelnemers zijn iedereen met een 2024 WCA ID en eerder. Alle deelnemers moeten daarnaast ook voldoen aan alle andere inschrijfeisen om de inschrijving te laten tellen. Inschrijvingen worden als volgt geaccepteerd: 25% van de competitor limit is gereserveerd voor nieuwkomers. De andere 75% voor terugkerende deelnemers gaat op volgorde van WCA inschrijving. Als meer dan 25% nieuwkomers inschrijven, voordat de overige 75% vol zit gaan zowel de nieuwkomers als de terugkerende deelnemers op volgorde van WCA inschrijving samen met de terugkomende deelnemers. Als de 25% van de competitor limit die gereserveerd is voor nieuwkomers niet vol raakt twee weken voordat de inschrijving dicht gaat, dan komen deze plekken beschikbaar voor zowel nieuwkomers als terugkerende deelnemers. Zie tabblad "Nieuwkomersactie"

items.name: Steel City Classic 2020
items.information: # The competition has been cancelled due to the COVID-19 outbreak. Join us for Steel City Classic 2020 in the heart of downtown Pittsburgh! Once the steel capital of the world, Pittsburgh has reinvented itself to be a home for many diverse industries and is also the home of several world champion professional sports teams. A new champion will be crowned right here on March 21st, will it be you? We welcome competitors from all speeds and skill levels and all guests as well. Come and see all that the speedcubing community has to offer! This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations Live results can be found on our WCA Live page, which will be available during the competition. Day 1 Events: 2x2x2 Cube, 3x3x3 Cube, 4x4x4 Cube, 5x5x5 Cube, 3x3x3 One-Handed, Pyraminx Day 2 Events: 6x6x6 Cube, 7x7x7 Cube, 3x3x3 Fewest Moves, Clock, Megaminx, 3x3x3 Blindfolded

items.name: Stockholmsligan Final 2023
items.information: Varmt välkomna till finaltävlingen i vårsäsongen av Stockholmsligan 2023! Mer information om Stockholmligans upplägg finns under fliken med samma namn. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida så du inte missar någon viktig information. Tävlingen har ett väldigt speciellt upplägg, där varje deltagare har totalt 18 minuter i lösningstid på sig att genomföra alla sina lösningar, och deltagaren får själv välja vilka grenar man vill spendera sin tid på. Notera dock att varje deltagare denna gång **får välja maximalt fem (5) grenar** att tävla i. **OBS:** Anmäler du dig till antingen 3x3x3 FMC eller 3x3x3 Multi-Blind så kan du endast tävla i just den grenen och inte tävla i någon annan gren på tävlingen. -- A warm welcome to final competition in the spring season of Stockholmsligan 2023! More information about the league's structure can be found under the tab with the same name. Please read through all the tabs on this page so you don't miss any important information. The competition has a very special format, where each competitor has a total of 18 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves, and the competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. Note, however, that each competitor this time **can choose a maximum of five (5) events** to compete in. **N.B.:** If you register for either 3x3x3 FMC or 3x3x3 Multi-Blind, you can only compete in that particular event and not compete in any other event at the competition.

items.information: Diese Speedcubing Meisterschaft, die "Suisse Toy Fast Fingers 2017" findet innerhalb der Suisse Toy 2017 in Bern statt. Die Suisse Toy ist die grösste Spielzeugmesse der Schweiz und wir dürfen voller Stolz den Leuten die Faszination unseres Sports demonstrieren. Die Startgebühren für alle Teilnehmer betragen einmalige 15Fr. Damit decken wir einen kleinen Teil der Standgebühren. In den Startgebühren ist der Eintrittspreis zur Suisse Toy nicht enthalten. Dieser muss an der Eingangskasse separat bezahlt werden. Die Suisse Toy dauern vom Donnerstag 12.Okt bis Sonntag 15. Oktober. items.information: **Português** O Summer Kube Boulevard Via Velha 2020 é o 11º Campeonato Oficial do Espírito Santo. Será um prazer recebê-los e temos algumas dicas para vocês, competidores e acompanhantes: - Chegue ao local da competição 30 minutos antes de modalidade que participará; - O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele; - No momento da premiação, no final do domingo, vamos sortear alguns cubos para os competidores. Só ganha quem estiver presente e ninguém pode ganhar duas vezes; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. A nossa competição é formada por alguns competidores experientes, mas sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas. - Procure se divertir bastante! **English** Summer Kube Boulevard Via Velha 2020 is the 11th Official Championship of Espírito Santo. It will be a pleasure to receive you and we have some tips for you, competitors and companions: - Arrive at the competition site 30 minutes before the modality that will participate; - The cube you will be competing in must be in good condition, so take good care of it; - At the time of the awards, at the end of Sunday, we will draw some cubes for the competitors. Only win who is present and no one can win twice; - If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. Our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, but we will always have room for new cubists. - Try to have a lot of fun!

Данные соревнования организованы при поддержки команды QBERS. 10 процетов от всех собранных средств будут отправлены в международную благотворительную организацию "Интеракт" Кыргызча Summer in Bishkek 2024 — Бишкек шаарында өтүүчү пазлдарды жогорку ылдамдыкта чогултуу боюнча ачык чемпионат. 1 дисциплинага негизги каттоо төлөмү 200 сом. 2 же андан көп дисциплиналар үчүн төлөм 700 сомду түзөт. Бул мелдештер QBERS командасынын колдоосу менен уюштурулууда. Бардык чогултулган каражаттардын 10 пайызы "Интеракт" эл аралык кайрымдуулук уюмуна жөнөтүлөт English Summer in Bishkek 2024 is an open championship in high-speed puzzle assembly in the city of Bishkek. items.information: Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna auto-sustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Aiming to a good fluence for the competition, at registering for a event, you compromise to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in the other you'll help as staff.

As the name suggests, it is crucial to maintain silence during all events. We'll have sufficient amount of breaks when it is ok to make some noise. ​ Эти соревнования включают в себя только дисциплины, на которых необходимо соблюдать тишину - 3х3х3 вслепую, 4х4х4 вслепую, 5х5х5 вслепую, 3х3х3 Мультиблайнд и 3х3х3 на количество ходов. Как следует из названия, чрезвычайно важно сохранять полную тишину во время всех дисциплин. У нас будет достаточное количество перерывов, во время которых можно будет пошуметь. ​ Ushbu musobaqada faqatgina tinchlik saqlash kerak bo'lgan yo'nalishlarni o'z ichiga oladi - 3x3x3 ko'zni yumib terish, 4x4x4 ko'zni yumib terish, 5x5x5 ko'zni yumib terish, 3x3x3 Multiblind, 3x3x3 harakatlar soniga terish. Musobaqaning nomidan kelib chiqqan holda, to'laqonli tinchlikni saqlash talab etiladi. Bizda shovqin qilish uchun yetarlicha tanaffuslar bo'ladi.

items.name: Supreme South Open 2017
items.information: Supreme South Open 2017 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the Rubik's Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

Wir müssen die T-Shirts bis zum 08.09.2024 vorbestellen. [EN] When registering, please indicate in the comments field whether you would like to buy a T-shirt for the Swiss Nationals or not. If you would like to buy a T-shirt, please let us know your size and if you want the T-shirt in white or cardinal-red. There will only be a very small, limited number of T-shirts available for purchase on site. The cost of the T-shirt is: CHF 25.00. You will pay the T-shirt at the registration desk. We must pre-order the T-shirts by 08.09.2024. [*EN*] As these are the official Swiss Speedcubing Championship, the best 12 Swiss competitors of the previous round as well as all participants of other nationalities in between qualify for the respective finals.

items.name: Swiss Science Open 2018
items.information: [DE] Die Swiss Science Open 2018 im Technorama werden nicht nur für Teilnehmer sondern auch für alle registrierten Gäste ein Erlebnis werden. Alle Teilnehmer und registrierten Gäste erhalten für 15CHF für Sa+So freien Eintritt ins Technorama. Dort erwarten euch neben der Speedcubing Competition im Foyer ganz viele Versuche aus der Welt der Physik, welche ihr ausprobieren könnt. Registriert euch und alle eure Begleitpersonen (Gäste) um für 2 Tage den freien Eintritt ins Technorama zu bekommen. [EN] The Swiss Science Open 2018 in the Technorama will be an experience not only for participants but also for all registered guests. All participants and registered guests receive for 15CHF for Sa + Sun free admission to the Technorama. In addition to the Speedcubing Competition in the foyer, you can expect many experiments from the world of physics, which you can try out. Register yourself and all your escorts (guests) to get free admission to the Technorama for 2 days.

items.name: Swisscubing Better Be Quick 2018
items.information: Pendant la pause de midi, nous allons faire des grillades. Nous comptons donc sur tous les compétiteurs d'apporter des salades, viandes ou autre (le top étant des spécialités de sa propre région) afin de le partager avec les autres compétiteurs. During lunch time we will do a big BBQ, so we hope that everyone will bring some salads, meat and other meals (the best option would be to bring specialities from your own region) in aim to share it with everyone. Während der Mittagspause werden wir grillieren. Darum hoffen wir dass alle Teilnehmer etwas zu essen mitbringen (Salat, Fleisch, Spezialität von zuhause) um es mit den anderen zu Teilen. Mentre la pausa di mezzogiorno faremo una grigliata. Speriamo che tutti porteranno delle insalate, della carne o altre cose (il meglio sono le specialità del vostro paese) da condividere con i altri concorrenti.
